resolution: BG1 (FD:L2608) sets a conservative lower bound for BRIDGE_MSG_MAX: 61440 (largest value) + 256 (largest key) + 128 (envelope reserve, the same 128-byte envelope bound that FD:L2711 uses for BR17e) = 61824. A build with BRIDGE_MSG_MAX = 61823 fails; 61824 is the smallest passing value; the default 65536 passes. The tight compact message (id 4294967295, 256-byte key, 61440-byte value, no escaping) is 61790 bytes, within the reserve. This is a reserve, not a contradiction; 0.4's U34 is withdrawn.
guardPrecedence: The Bpre size guard runs before parsing (FD:L1128). A value whose UTF-8 length is within str(61440) can still be rejected as size when JSON escaping makes the message exceed 65536 bytes; the reply is then -32600 {reason:'size'} with id null and no token, never a B3 error. Senders that need a byte-exact large value must avoid characters JSON must escape. The baseline limit is unchanged.

cases.note: the value is 33000 UTF-8 bytes (accepted by str(61440)) but serializes to 66000 characters
